submission.implementation_notes: Compiled with Plinth 1.65.0.0 and the `datatypes=BuiltinCasing` plugin flag. Builtin casing has been a mainnet feature since the van Rossem hard fork (protocol version 11, 2026-07-18); plutus-tx-plugin 1.67 dropped the flag and enables casing under the default `SumsOfProducts`. Emits the batch-6 `dropList` builtin for cursor gaps of three or more fields in the typed decoder (gated behind the same build flag, so the non-casing sibling for this line stays byte-identical). This round further cuts the accept path: it compares the compile-time script credential instead of locating the own input by out-ref, fuses the withdrawal scan into the seller-payment fold, shares one `TxInfo` spine walk across inputs/outputs/signatories, reads lovelace positionally with `adaOf` instead of an assetAmount key lookup, and locates the single deposit output with `findUniqueE` in one pass. total_fee 83342 to 62722 lovelace (-24.7%).
